admission.justification: Delivering a deterministic, script-off-readable, verified static VitePress site requires fail-closed Markdown transforms, atomic compiler rendering, width-budgeted stage mini-maps, MathJax 3 editorial light components and dual-repo CI/Pages isolation to hold together.

guarantee: Invoking rh-build-site and VitePress against validated stage docs, Concept Cards, SVG assets, audit snapshots and DAG data deterministically produces a script-off-readable, build-time MathJax 3 editorial light static site with width-budgeted unique-ID stage mini-maps and ZoomTabs outline/hash/history navigation without mutating .vitepress/, guarded on every code PR by quality.yml site-build-check and deployed from ar-rh-proof-skeleton.
title: Phase 4 deterministic static-site compiler, VitePress theme and dual-repo CI
